Name: JumJum Jr.
Author: ProJared
Description:
JumJum Jr. lives on!

Straight from the old lands of Haven & Hearth, JumJum Jr. can now protect YOUR farm!

This is a simple Craftables replacement mod. Download the file, and place it in Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/TileSheets folder. That's all. Replace the Craftables.xnb in there and you're good to go. (Feel free to make a separate copy of yours for backup though!)

JumJum Jr. replaces Rarecrow #8 (the tiki head one). You receive that after donating 40 items to the museum.

Enjoy!
